title: Kerala Government Launches 'Punarjani' Model Township for Wayanad Landslide Survivors
malayalam_title: വയനാട് ദുരന്തബാധിതർക്കായി 'പുനർജനി' മാതൃകാ ടൗൺഷിപ്പ് പദ്ധതി പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു
summary: The Government of Kerala unveiled the comprehensive rehabilitation master plan 'Punarjani' to construct a safe, climate-resilient model township for families displaced by the catastrophic Chooralmala and Mundakkai landslides in Wayanad.
key_points: The township incorporates earthquake and disaster-resistant housing units, primary health center, school, community center, and market facilities.
Funded via the Chief Minister's Distress Relief Fund (CMDRF) and institutional sponsors.
State-of-the-art geological zoning applied to ensure high land safety factor.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What is the name of the comprehensive model township rehabilitation project initiated by the Government of Kerala for Wayanad landslide survivors?
psc_potential_question.explanation: 'Punarjani' is the Kerala Government's rehabilitation township project designed for families displaced by the Chooralmala-Mundakkai landslides.

title: Legendary Studio Ghibli Co-Founder Hayao Miyazaki Awarded 2024 Ramon Magsaysay Award
malayalam_title: പ്രശസ്ത ആനിമേഷൻ സംവിധായകൻ ഹയാവോ മിയാസാക്കിക്ക് റാമോൺ മഗ്സസെ അവാർഡ്
summary: Japanese animation maestro and Studio Ghibli co-founder Hayao Miyazaki was conferred the 66th Ramon Magsaysay Award, widely regarded as the 'Nobel Prize of Asia', for using art to illuminate the human condition and inspire environmental stewardship.
key_points: Miyazaki is famous for animated masterpieces such as 'Spirited Away' (Oscar winner), 'My Neighbor Totoro', 'Princess Mononoke', and 'The Boy and the Heron' (2024 Oscar winner).
The Ramon Magsaysay Award was established in 1957 in memory of the 7th President of the Philippines.
First Indian recipient was Acharya Vinoba Bhave (1958).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the first Indian to receive the prestigious Ramon Magsaysay Award in 1958?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Acharya Vinoba Bhave was the first Indian recipient of the Ramon Magsaysay Award for Community Leadership in 1958. Studio Ghibli's Hayao Miyazaki received the 2024 honour.

title: Meenangadi in Wayanad Honoured as India's Model Carbon Neutral Panchayat
malayalam_title: ഇന്ത്യയിലെ മാതൃകാ കാർബൺ ന്യൂട്രൽ ഗ്രാമപഞ്ചായത്തായി വയനാട്ടിലെ മീനങ്ങാടി
summary: Meenangadi Grama Panchayat in Wayanad district was recognized at national environmental forums for its pioneer 'Carbon Neutral Meenangadi' project, aiming to achieve net zero carbon emissions through extensive tree planting, energy auditing, and sustainable farming.
key_points: First local self-governing body in India to initiate a structured carbon neutral project (launched in 2016).
Introduced 'Tree Banking' scheme where farmers receive interest-free loans from cooperative banks for nurturing trees.
Serves as the pilot benchmark for Kerala’s climate resilience local governance model.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which Grama Panchayat in Kerala is recognized as India's first structured Carbon Neutral Panchayat?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Meenangadi in Wayanad launched India's first Carbon Neutral Panchayat initiative in 2016, introducing tree banking and greenhouse gas auditing.

title: Kerala Tourism Wins Prestigious PATA Gold Award 2024 for 'Holiday Heist' Campaign
malayalam_title: കേരള ടൂറിസത്തിന് അന്താരാഷ്ട്ര പാറ്റ (PATA) ഗോൾഡ് അവാർഡ്
summary: Kerala Tourism secured the prestigious Pacific Asia Travel Association (PATA) Gold Award 2024 in the Digital Marketing Campaign category for its pioneering online bidding campaign titled 'Holiday Heist'.
key_points: 'Holiday Heist' was a creative digital bidding game that allowed tourists to win vacation packages across Kerala through lowest unique bids on WhatsApp.
PATA awards recognize exceptional achievements in the travel and tourism industry across the Asia Pacific region.
Kerala Tourism has previously won multiple PATA honours for Responsible Tourism and Village Life Experience initiatives.

psc_potential_question.question_text: For which digital marketing campaign did Kerala Tourism win the PATA Gold Award in 2024?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Kerala Tourism won the PATA Gold Award for 'Holiday Heist', an innovative WhatsApp-based bidding game engaging millions of domestic travelers.

title: India's First Generative AI Teacher Robot 'Iris' Unveiled in Thiruvananthapuram School
malayalam_title: ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ആദ്യ ജനറേറ്റീവ് എ.ഐ അധ്യാപിക റോബോട്ട് 'ഐറിസ്' തിരുവനന്തപുരത്ത് അവതരിപ്പിച്ചു
summary: KTCT Higher Secondary School in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala introduced 'Iris', India’s first AI-powered humanoid teacher robot developed in collaboration with Makerlabs Edutech under Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL).
key_points: Equipped with wheels for mobility, voice recognition, and generative AI capabilities.
Can converse fluently in three languages and answer complex academic queries from kindergarten to higher secondary level.
Demonstrates Kerala’s lead in pedagogical technology innovation.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What is the name of India's first AI-powered humanoid teacher robot introduced in a school in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Iris is India's first AI teacher humanoid robot, introduced at KTCT Higher Secondary School, Thiruvananthapuram.

title: Poet P. Raman Wins 54th Odakkuzhal Award for 'Rathri Pantrandarakku Oru Thaaraattu'
malayalam_title: 54-ാമത് ഓടക്കുഴൽ അവാർഡ് കവി പി. രാമന് ('രാത്രി പന്ത്രണ്ടരയ്ക്ക് ഒരു താരാട്ട്')
summary: Distinguished poet P. Raman was chosen for the 54th Odakkuzhal Award instituted by the Guruvayurappa Chembakaraman Smaraka Trust (founded by Mahakavi G. Sankara Kurup) for his poetry collection 'Rathri Pantrandarakku Oru Thaaraattu'.
key_points: Carries a cash prize of ₹30,000, a citation, and a sculpture.
Instituted by G. Sankara Kurup in 1968 using a part of his Jnanpith prize money.
First recipient was Vennikkulam Gopala Kurup for 'Thulasidasa Ramayanam' (1969).

psc_potential_question.question_text: The Odakkuzhal Award was instituted by which Jnanpith laureate using a portion of his prize money?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Mahakavi G. Sankara Kurup, India's first Jnanpith recipient (1965 for Odakkuzhal), instituted the Odakkuzhal Award in 1968.

title: Eminent Poet K. Satchidanandan Conferred 34th Vallathol Award
malayalam_title: 34-ാമത് വള്ളത്തോൾ പുരസ്കാരം പ്രമുഖ കവി കെ. സച്ചിദാനന്ദന്
summary: Renowned poet, literary theorist, and Kerala Sahitya Akademi President K. Satchidanandan was conferred the 34th Vallathol Award in recognition of his lifetime contributions to Malayalam and Indian literature.
key_points: Instituted in 1991 by the Vallathol Sahitya Samithi in memory of Mahakavi Vallathol Narayana Menon.
Carries a purse of ₹1,11,111, a plaque, and citation.
First recipient of the Vallathol Award was legendary scholar Pala Narayanan Nair (1991).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was the first recipient of the prestigious Vallathol Award instituted in 1991 in memory of Mahakavi Vallathol Narayana Menon?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Pala Narayanan Nair was the first recipient of the Vallathol Award in 1991. The 2024 award was conferred on K. Satchidanandan.

title: Cabinet Approves Chandrayaan-4 Lunar Sample Return Mission and Venus Orbiter Mission (Shukrayaan)
malayalam_title: ചന്ദ്രനിൽ നിന്ന് സാമ്പിളുകൾ ഭൂമിയിലെത്തിക്കുന്ന ചന്ദ്രയാൻ-4 ദൗത്യത്തിന് കേന്ദ്ര മന്ത്രിസഭയുടെ അനുമതി
summary: The Union Cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi officially approved ISRO’s Chandrayaan-4 mission, designed to collect surface and subsurface rock/soil samples from the Moon and safely return them to Earth.
key_points: Chandrayaan-4 involves five distinct modules: Ascender, Descender, Re-entry, Transfer, and Propulsion.
Requires two separate launches of ISRO's LVM3 heavy-lift launch vehicle with space docking in lunar orbit.
The Cabinet also approved the Venus Orbiter Mission (VOM) with an allocation of ₹1,236 crore to study Venusian atmosphere.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What is the primary scientific objective of ISRO's approved Chandrayaan-4 lunar mission?

options.text: Collecting lunar samples and returning them safely to Earth
Landing human astronauts on the lunar surface
Establishing a permanent base at the Moon's South Pole

psc_potential_question.explanation: Chandrayaan-4 is ISRO's lunar sample-return mission to collect and return Moon rocks and soil back to Earth.

title: KFON Achieves 100% Connectivity Across Government Schools and Local Body Offices in Kerala
malayalam_title: കേരളത്തിലെ എല്ലാ സർക്കാർ വിദ്യാലയങ്ങളിലും തദ്ദേശ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങളിലും കെ-ഫോൺ കണക്റ്റിവിറ്റി പൂർത്തിയായി
summary: Kerala Fibre Optic Network (KFON), the state government's flagship optical fiber infrastructure, completed gigabit connectivity across all 14 districts, delivering free high-speed broadband to economically disadvantaged families and government offices.
key_points: Kerala is the first state in India to declare access to high-speed Internet as a basic human right (2019).
KFON holds Category-1 Internet Service Provider (ISP) and Infrastructure Provider (IP-1) licenses from the Department of Telecommunications (DoT).
Over 30,000 km of optical fiber cable laid across the state.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which was the first state in India to declare access to the Internet as a basic human right?
psc_potential_question.explanation: In 2019, Kerala became the first Indian state to declare the Right to Internet as a basic human right, backed by the KFON project.

title: Dommaraju Gukesh Becomes Youngest World Chess Championship Challenger in History
malayalam_title: ചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രായം കുറഞ്ഞ ലോക ചെസ്സ് കിരീട പോരാളിയായി ഡി. ഗുകേഷ്
summary: Indian Grandmaster D. Gukesh created chess history in Toronto, Canada, by winning the FIDE Candidates Tournament 2024 at just 17 years of age, becoming the youngest player ever to challenge for the World Chess Championship.
key_points: Broke Garry Kasparov's 40-year-old record (who qualified for the 1984 world title match at age 20).
Only the second Indian player after five-time World Champion Viswanathan Anand to win the Candidates tournament.
Earned the right to challenge China's Ding Liren for the World Chess Championship.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who broke Garry Kasparov's 40-year-old record to become the youngest player in history to win the FIDE Candidates Chess Tournament?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Dommaraju Gukesh won the 2024 Candidates in Toronto at age 17, becoming the youngest world championship challenger in chess history.

title: 106th Constitutional Amendment Act: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam Reserves 33% Seats for Women
malayalam_title: 106-ാമത് ഭരണഘടനാ ഭേദഗതി: ലോക്സഭയിലും നിയമസഭകളിലും സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് 33% സംവരണം
summary: The Parliament enacted the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act (The Constitution 128th Amendment Bill), officially known as the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, granting 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and the Legislative Assembly of NCT of Delhi.
key_points: Inserted Articles 330A, 332A, and amended Article 239AA.
Inserted Article 334A introducing a sunset clause of 15 years from commencement.
First bill introduced and passed in the newly constructed Parliament building (Samsad Bhavan).
Implementation linked to the delimitation exercise conducted after the first census following the enactment.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which Constitutional Amendment Act is known as the 'Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam' providing 33% reservation for women in Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023 (128th Amendment Bill) enacted the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam for 33% women representation.

title: Prime Minister Launches 'PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana' for 1 Crore Households
malayalam_title: 1 കോടി വീടുകളിൽ സൗരോർജ്ജ സംവിധാനം സ്ഥാപിക്കുന്ന 'പി.എം സൂര്യഘർ: മുഫ്ത് ബിജിലി യോജന' ആരംഭിച്ചു
summary: The Central Government launched the 'PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana' with an outlay of ₹75,021 crore to provide free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore households through rooftop solar installations.
key_points: Provides central financial assistance (subsidy) up to ₹78,000 for a 3 kW solar plant.
Promotes urban local bodies and panchayats to establish model solar villages.
Expected to add 30 GW of solar capacity through residential rooftop systems, reducing carbon emissions by 720 million tonnes.

psc_potential_question.question_text: What is the maximum amount of free electricity provided per month to households under the 'PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana'?
psc_potential_question.explanation: The PM Surya Ghar scheme aims to install rooftop solar panels for 1 crore households, providing up to 300 units of free power each month.

title: Sarada Muraleedharan IAS Appointed as 48th Chief Secretary of Kerala
malayalam_title: ശാരദ മുരളീധരൻ ഐ.എ.എസ് കേരളത്തിന്റെ 48-ാമത് ചീഫ് സെക്രട്ടറിയായി ചുമതലയേറ്റു
summary: Senior bureaucrat Sarada Muraleedharan IAS of the 1990 batch assumed office as the 48th Chief Secretary of Kerala, succeeding her husband Dr. V. Venu IAS.
key_points: She is the fifth woman Chief Secretary in the history of Kerala (following Padma Ramachandran, Lizzie Jacob, Neela Gangadharan, and Nalini Netto).
Remarkable milestone where a wife took over charge directly from her husband as the state’s top civil servant.
She previously served as Executive Director of Kudumbashree Mission (2006–2012) and Director General of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT).

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who is the 5th woman Chief Secretary of Kerala who assumed office in 2024, succeeding Dr. V. Venu IAS?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Sarada Muraleedharan IAS took charge as the 48th Chief Secretary of Kerala, becoming the 5th woman to hold the position.

title: India Lifts ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 Trophy Defeating South Africa in Barbados
malayalam_title: ദക്ഷിണാഫ്രിക്കയെ പരാജയപ്പെടുത്തി 2024-ലെ ടി20 ലോകകപ്പ് കിരീടം ചൂടി ഇന്ത്യ
summary: India defeated South Africa by 7 runs in a thrilling final at the Kensington Oval, Bridgetown, Barbados to win the 2024 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, ending an 11-year ICC trophy drought.
key_points: India became the first team to win the ICC Men's T20 World Cup undefeated throughout the entire tournament.
Virat Kohli was named Player of the Match in the final (76 runs off 59 balls).
Jasprit Bumrah was awarded Player of the Tournament (15 wickets at an economy of 4.17).
Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Ravindra Jadeja announced retirement from T20 International cricket following the triumph.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who was awarded the 'Player of the Tournament' in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 won by India?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Jasprit Bumrah won the Player of the Tournament award for his extraordinary bowling performance throughout the tournament.

title: Manu Bhaker Becomes First Athlete from Independent India to Win Two Medals at a Single Olympic Games
malayalam_title: ഒരൊറ്റ ഒളിമ്പിക്സിൽ രണ്ട് മെഡലുകൾ നേടുന്ന സ്വതന്ത്ര ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ആദ്യ കായികതാരമായി മനു ഭാകർ
summary: Ace shooter Manu Bhaker scripted history at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games by winning two bronze medals: the Women’s 10m Air Pistol individual and the 10m Air Pistol Mixed Team event alongside Sarabjot Singh.
key_points: First woman shooter from India to win an Olympic medal.
First athlete from independent India to win two medals at the same Olympic edition (Norman Pritchard won two silvers for British India in 1900).
Hails from Jhajjar district, Haryana.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who became the first athlete of independent India to win two medals at a single edition of the Olympic Games (Paris 2024)?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Manu Bhaker won two bronze medals in pistol shooting at Paris 2024, becoming the first athlete from independent India to achieve this milestone.

title: PR Sreejesh Retires with Paris Olympic Bronze; Hockey India Retires Iconic Jersey No. 16
malayalam_title: പാരീസ് ഒളിമ്പിക്സ് വെങ്കലത്തോടെ പി.ആർ. ശ്രീജേഷ് വിരമിച്ചു; ജേഴ്സി നമ്പർ 16 ന് വിരമിക്കൽ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ച് ഹോക്കി ഇന്ത്യ
summary: Legendary Indian goalkeeper Parattu Raveendran Sreejesh of Kerala retired from international hockey after anchoring India to its second consecutive Olympic bronze medal in Paris. Hockey India retired his iconic Jersey No. 16.
key_points: Sreejesh is only the third Indian hockey player to win two Olympic medals (Tokyo 2020 Bronze & Paris 2024 Bronze) in the post-independence era.
Awarded Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award (2021) and World Games Athlete of the Year (2021).
Appointed Head Coach of the Indian Junior Men’s Hockey Team and Brand Ambassador for Kerala Adventure Tourism.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which jersey number of Indian hockey goalkeeper P.R. Sreejesh was permanently retired by Hockey India upon his retirement after Paris 2024 Olympics?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Hockey India retired the iconic Jersey No. 16 in honor of Kerala's legendary goalkeeper P.R. Sreejesh following his 18-year international career.

title: Jenny Erpenbeck and Michael Hofmann Win 2024 International Booker Prize for 'Kairos'
malayalam_title: 2024-ലെ അന്താരാഷ്ട്ര ബുക്കർ പുരസ്കാരം ജെന്നി എർപൻബെക്കിന്റെ 'കൈറോസ്' എന്ന നോവലിന്
summary: German author Jenny Erpenbeck and translator Michael Hofmann won the 2024 International Booker Prize for 'Kairos', a tragic love affair set in East Berlin during the collapse of the Berlin Wall and the dissolution of East Germany.
key_points: Jenny Erpenbeck became the first German author to win the International Booker Prize.
Michael Hofmann became the first male translator to win the award.
The £50,000 prize money is shared equally between the author and the translator.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Who is the first German writer to win the International Booker Prize in 2024 for the novel 'Kairos'?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Jenny Erpenbeck became the first German author to win the International Booker Prize for her novel 'Kairos', translated by Michael Hofmann.

title: British Novelist Samantha Harvey Wins 2024 Booker Prize for Space Novella 'Orbital'
malayalam_title: 2024-ലെ ബുക്കർ പുരസ്കാരം ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് എഴുത്തുകാരി സാമന്ത ഹാർവിയുടെ 'ഓർബിറ്റൽ' എന്ന നോവലിന്
summary: British author Samantha Harvey won the 2024 Booker Prize for her compact and contemplative novel 'Orbital', set aboard the International Space Station over the course of a single day as astronauts circle Earth 16 times.
key_points: At 136 pages, 'Orbital' is the second-shortest novel ever to win the Booker Prize (after Penelope Fitzgerald’s 'Offshore' in 1979).
It is the first Booker Prize-winning novel situated entirely in outer space.
The Booker Prize is awarded annually to the best novel written in English and published in the UK and Ireland.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which novel won the prestigious 2024 Booker Prize for British author Samantha Harvey?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Samantha Harvey won the 2024 Booker Prize for 'Orbital', a poetic reflection on Earth viewed from the International Space Station.

title: 70th National Film Awards: Malayalam Movie 'Aattam' Wins Best Feature Film
malayalam_title: 70-ാമത് ദേശീയ ചലച്ചിത്ര പുരസ്കാരം: മലയാള ചിത്രം 'ആട്ടം' മികച്ച ഫീച്ചർ ഫിലിം
summary: The chamber suspense drama 'Aattam' (The Play), written and directed by debutant Anand Ekarshi, won the prestigious Golden Lotus (Swarna Kamal) for Best Feature Film at the 70th National Film Awards.
key_points: Aattam also won the National Film Awards for Best Screenplay (Anand Ekarshi) and Best Editing (Mahesh Bhuvanend).
Best Actor (Male): Rishab Shetty for 'Kantara' (Kannada).
Best Actor (Female): Jointly awarded to Nithya Menen ('Thiruchitrambalam' - Tamil) and Manasi Parekh ('Kutch Express' - Gujarati).
Best Non-Feature Film: 'Ayena' (Mirror) directed by Siddhant Sarin.

psc_potential_question.question_text: Which Malayalam film won the prestigious Best Feature Film award (Swarna Kamal) at the 70th National Film Awards?
psc_potential_question.explanation: Anand Ekarshi's debut film 'Aattam' won Best Feature Film, Best Screenplay, and Best Editing at the 70th National Film Awards.

title: E. Santhosh Kumar Selected for 48th Vayalar Rama Varma Memorial Literary Award
malayalam_title: 48-ാമത് വയലാർ രാമവർമ്മ സ്മാരക സാഹിത്യ പുരസ്കാരം ഇ. സന്തോഷ് കുമാറിന്
summary: Renowned Malayalam novelist and short story writer E. Santhosh Kumar was chosen for the prestigious 48th Vayalar Rama Varma Memorial Literary Award for his short story collection 'Naraka Mohanangalum Mattu Kathakalum'.
key_points: The award carries a cash prize of ₹1 lakh, a bronze sculpture designed by Kanayi Kunhiraman, and a citation.
E. Santhosh Kumar has previously won the Kerala Sahitya Akademi Award for 'Chidambara Rahasyam' (novel) and 'Chavukali' (short story).
The Vayalar Award was instituted in 1977 in memory of poet and lyricist Vayalar Rama Varma. First recipient was Lalithambika Antharjanam for 'Agnisakshi'.

psc_potential_question.question_text: For which work was E. Santhosh Kumar chosen for the 48th Vayalar Rama Varma Memorial Literary Award in 2024?
psc_potential_question.explanation: E. Santhosh Kumar won the 48th Vayalar Award for 'Naraka Mohanangalum Mattu Kathakalum'. The first recipient of the Vayalar Award was Lalithambika Antharjanam in 1977.

title: Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, and James A. Robinson Win 2024 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences
malayalam_title: സാമ്പത്തിക ശാസ്ത്ര നൊബേൽ ഡാരൺ അസെമോഗ്ലു, സൈമൺ ജോൺസൺ, ജെയിംസ് റോബിൻസൺ എന്നിവർക്ക്
summary: The Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel 2024 was awarded to Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, and James A. Robinson for comparative studies on how political and economic institutions are formed and affect long-term prosperity.
key_points: Renowned for formulating the concepts of 'Inclusive Institutions' versus 'Extractive Institutions' in their landmark book 'Why Nations Fail'.
Demonstrated that societies with weak rule of law and institutions that exploit the population generate neither growth nor positive change.
All three laureates are based at leading US institutions (MIT and University of Chicago).

psc_potential_question.question_text: The famous book 'Why Nations Fail: The Origins of Power, Prosperity, and Poverty' was co-authored by which 2024 Economics Nobel laureates?

options.text: Daron Acemoglu and James A. Robinson

psc_potential_question.explanation: Daron Acemoglu and James A. Robinson authored 'Why Nations Fail', demonstrating that inclusive political and economic institutions drive prosperity.

title: Japanese Anti-Nuclear Grassroots Movement Nihon Hidankyo Wins 2024 Nobel Peace Prize
